CHIN 103.description: Five hundred of the most commonly used Chinese characters. Emphasis is on the phonetic and significant elements common to large groups of ideograms.
CHIN 103.subject: CHIN
CHIN 103.title: Introduction to Chinese Calligraphy

CHIN 121.description: Grammar and practical vocabulary necessary for fundamental communication skills. Assumes no prior experience in the language.
CHIN 121.subject: CHIN
CHIN 121.title: Elementary Chinese Mandarin

CHIN 122.description: Practice and further development of essential listening, reading, speaking, and writing skills.
CHIN 122.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in CHIN 121.
CHIN 122.subject: CHIN
CHIN 122.title: Basic Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese

CHIN 221.description: Continued practice of basic sentence patterns used in modern speech with increased emphasis on reading and acquisition of additional characters.
CHIN 221.subject: CHIN
CHIN 221.title: Intermediate Mandarin Chinese

CHIN 222.description: Continued practice of basic sentence patterns used in modern speech with increased emphasis on reading and acquisition of additional characters.
CHIN 222.subject: CHIN
CHIN 222.title: Intermediate Mandarin Chinese II

CHIN 240.description: Introduction to Chinese culture, heritage, and modern societies. Readings selected from printed and online sources. Taught in English.
CHIN 240.subject: CHIN
CHIN 240.title: Chinese Culture, Tradition, and Modern Societies

CHIN 321.description: Provides advanced intermediate training in spoken and written Chinese. By increasing students’ vocabulary and knowledge of sentence patterns, the course focuses on speaking and writing in coherent, well-formed paragraphs.
CHIN 321.subject: CHIN
CHIN 321.title: Advanced intermediate Mandarin Chinese I

CHIN 322.description: Continues advanced intermediate training in spoken and written Chinese. Attention is given to complex grammatical patterns, discourse characteristics, and discussions of cultural topics.
CHIN 322.subject: CHIN
CHIN 322.title: Advanced Intermediate Mandarin Chinese II

CHIN 335.description: Introduces the connection between gender and the Chinese national imagination. Readings include cultural and historical documents that purport to explain the experience of women in China. Readings in English. Taught in English.
CHIN 335.subject: CHIN
CHIN 335.title: Women in China

CHIN 340.description: An introduction to the most important works, authors, genres, and themes of Chinese literature from the first millennium B.C.E. to 1911.
CHIN 340.subject: CHIN
CHIN 340.title: Introduction to Premodern Chinese Literature

CHIN 341.description: Readings of canonical texts from modern Chinese literature. A focus is on the role of literature and other cultural documents in the imagination of China as a modern nation. Readings and discussion in English.
CHIN 341.subject: CHIN
CHIN 341.title: Modern Chinese Literature

CHIN 365.description: Survey of Chinese language cinema. Chinese film history and vocabulary with which to discuss film texts. Covers classic leftwing cinema, Hong Kong martial arts films, as well as the Hong Kong, Taiwan, and PRC New Waves. Taught in English. Films subtitled.
CHIN 365.subject: CHIN
CHIN 365.title: Screening China

CHIN 398.description: Intensive study in selected authors or literary movements of China, including cultural aspects. May be repeated for credit under different titles. Taught in English.
CHIN 398.subject: CHIN
CHIN 398.title: Selected Topics

CHIN 399.description: Contract approved by instructor, advisor, and department chair is required for undergraduate students.
CHIN 399.subject: CHIN
CHIN 399.title: Independent Study

CHIN 421.description: Acquisition of advanced grammar and vocabulary. Emphasis on building oral proficiency in professional settings.
CHIN 421.subject: CHIN
CHIN 421.title: Advanced Chinese I

CHIN 422.description: Continued acquisition of advanced grammar and vocabulary. Emphasis on expanding communicative abilities in a wider variety of interpersonal situations.
CHIN 422.subject: CHIN
CHIN 422.title: Advanced Chinese II

CHIN 518.description: An overview of the linguistic structure of Mandarin Chinese through investigation of the phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax, and lexicon as well as some aspects of sociolinguistics of the language.
CHIN 518.subject: CHIN
CHIN 518.title: Introduction to Chinese Linguistics: Structure of Chinese

CHIN 550.description: Advanced special topics in Chinese studies. May be repeated as content varies by title.
CHIN 550.subject: CHIN
CHIN 550.title: Advanced Special Topics in Chinese Studies

CHIN 777.description: Supervised direction of foreign language teaching in college. Required of all graduate assistants who are teaching. This course will not count toward the MA or PhD degree.
CHIN 777.subject: CHIN
CHIN 777.title: Supervised Instruction in Teaching Foreign Languages in College
